chunk_load.tolerance: set(dimension,x,z,new); ignore order and tick; server-start observation <= event < quit on both sides, including spawn warm-up before join; no spatial exclusions

hotbar.tolerance: exact (old,new,cancelled) sequence; relative to first event, +/-1 server tick versus script and between servers; cancel 7 leaves 3 selected, last request is a no-op; Horizon post only for accepted changes

moisture.tolerance: random_tick_speed=1024 for 400 server ticks after 40 settle ticks; compare set(pos,from,to,cancelled) and final blocks (dry=dirt or grass after natural spread, wet=7, cancelled=7); ignore tick and repeated cancelled attempts, whose multiset is random
